# Simpson Investment Properties

> Simpson Investment Properties is a real estate investment company owned by Zach Simpson. It buys houses for cash in Little Rock and Central Arkansas, as-is, with no repairs, commissions, or fees to the seller. Phone (469) 490-6776. Email simpsonpropsllc@gmail.com.
